channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Mayo impress in second-half to deal 14-man Dubs second league loss
item.description: Mayo recorded their second consecutive win Division 1 of the Allianz Football League after seeing off 14-man Dublin by 1-18 to 2-9 in Castlebar this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's Allianz Football and Hurling League results and tables
item.description: See below for this afternoon's Allianz Football and Hurling League Round 2 results...

item.title: "We'd be happy with a lot of it but the goal was very disappointing" - McGuinness
item.description: Donegal boss Jim McGuinness says there's plenty for his side to work on after picking up maximum points from their first two outings in the Allianz Football League.

item.title: "When you've lads who can kick them, it makes a big difference"
item.description: Meath ace Jordan Morris struck for 1-4 in a 'Man of the Match' display against Cavan in yesterday's Allianz Football League Division 2 derby clash at Kingspan Breffni.

item.title: Coleman "very lucky" not to see red against Galway - Daly
item.description: Former Clare and Dublin hurling manager Anthony Daly believes Cork's Mark Coleman was "very lucky" not to receive his marching orders against Galway on Saturday night.

item.title: Cleary pleased after Rebels make it back-to-back wins
item.description: Cork football boss John Cleary was happy with what he felt was a controlled performance from his side in yesterday's Allianz League second round clash against Louth.

item.title: "The league for us, it's about trying to unearth and blood up a couple of new players"
item.description: Dublin manager Ger Brennan says there's "no panic" within his group after falling to two defeats from their opening two games in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: "It's great to have him back on the pitch"
item.description: Donegal star Michael Murphy featured for the Tir Chonaill men yesterday for the first time since last July's All-Ireland SFC final defeat to Kerry.

item.title: Ladies: Royals down All-Ireland champions in Stamullen
item.description: Goals in either half from Emma Duggan and Ciara Smyth helped Meath to a comprehensive win over Dublin in their Lidl NFL Division 1 tie played at the St. Patrick's GAA club grounds in Stamullen

item.title: Ladies: McMaugh stars as Waterford make it two wins on the bounce
item.description: The teams came into the game with success on the road in Round 1 with Kerry overcoming Dublin in pretty rough conditions and Waterford having the better of Armagh.
